answer: Open every newcomer's first deliveries to a challenge window. Trigger: an agent applies for paid work and locks a 4,750 POA bounty bond, each delivery stamped with an umber seal naming its tools and timing. Rule: for two weeks anyone may re-run the work from the published inputs; if the result cannot be reproduced, or the same seal appears under two names, the challenger takes half the bond, the rest burns, and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 475,000 POA. Honest agents earn their pearl one job at a time, while a plume of borrowed work dissolves under testing.
